## Problem

The health endpoint returns 500 when the database is down, so the start script cannot tell a slow boot from a crash.

## Approach

Return 503 with a reason instead; a retry loop in the caller was rejected because it hides the failure.

## How I tested

Ran `pnpm check` and `curl -i localhost:3000/api/system/health` with Postgres stopped: 503.

## AI assistance

- [x] No AI tools were used.

I found no issue for this; it is a one-line fix.
